description: Unit test class for DefaultEffectedSubjects, testing immutability, equals/hashCode, getter behavior, and exception handling.

classes.name: DefaultEffectedSubjectsTest
classes.description: A set of unit tests verifying behavior of DefaultEffectedSubjects class, including immutability, equality, and collection behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DefaultEffectedSubjects instances are immutable and have immutable elements.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultEffectedSubjects properly implements equals and hashCode using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullRevoked
